moves.name: Kettlebell deadlift
cues: Send your hips back. Keep your back in its natural position.
Stand tall through your whole feet. Don’t lean back.
moves.notes: Bell between your feet. Soften your knees, hinge at the hips, and grip with both hands. Keep arms long. Stand smoothly, then hinge to lower. If you cannot reach the floor comfortably, practise an unloaded hinge.

moves.name: Goblet squat
moves.reps: Start with 3 reps · Bodyweight is welcome
cues: Start with bodyweight if 12 kg feels heavy.
Keep heels down. Use a comfortable depth.
moves.notes: Hold the bell close to your chest with both hands. Bend hips and knees, keeping knees aligned with toes. Stand smoothly. First learn an unloaded sit-to-stand from a stable chair against a wall. Only add the bell when you can position and hold it comfortably.

moves.name: Supported row
cues: Brace your free hand on a sturdy bench or counter.
Pull your elbow toward your hip. Keep your torso still.
moves.notes: Use a staggered stance and hinge at the hips. Support your free hand on a sturdy surface. Start with the bell hanging below your shoulder. Pull toward your lower ribs and lower slowly. Do not twist or shrug; use a lighter weight if needed.

moves.name: Wall push-up
cues: Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Feet closer to the wall makes it easier.
moves.notes: Hands on the wall at chest height, slightly wider than shoulders. Step back and bend elbows about 30–45 degrees from your sides. Bring your chest toward the wall, then push away. Keep breathing.

moves.name: Suitcase hold
cues: Stand tall, shoulders level. Don’t lean sideways.
Breathe normally. Set the bell down before switching.
moves.notes: Pick up the bell with a hip hinge and hold it beside one thigh. Keep shoulders level and arm straight. Start with 10–15 seconds per hand. Set it down before changing hands. Stop early if grip or posture fades.

warmupMoves.name: Easy march
cues: Lift one foot at a time, keeping the steps gentle.
Let your arms swing naturally and keep breathing.
warmupMoves.notes: March gently in place or walk around your space. Lift your feet only as high as is comfortable. No kettlebell needed.

warmupMoves.name: Unloaded hip hinge
cues: Soften your knees and send your hips back.
Keep your back in its natural position. Stand smoothly.
warmupMoves.notes: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and arms crossed over your chest. Soften your knees, then send your hips back while your torso tips forward. Keep your back in its natural position. Stand smoothly and pause between a few repetitions. No weight needed.

warmupMoves.name: Chair sit-to-stand
cues: Use a stable chair against a wall. Keep feet flat.
Lean forward gently and stand through your whole feet.
warmupMoves.notes: Place a sturdy chair against a wall. Sit near the front of the seat with your feet flat under your knees. Reach your empty hands forward, lean forward gently, and stand. Sit back down with control. Use a comfortable range and pause as needed. No kettlebell.

warmupMoves.name: Shoulder rolls
cues: Let your arms hang comfortably at your sides.
Circle your shoulders gently. Keep the movement small.
warmupMoves.notes: Stand comfortably with your arms relaxed. Gently roll your shoulders up, back, down, and forward in small comfortable circles. Keep breathing; avoid forcing a range or shrugging hard.

warmup.name: Easy march
cues: March gently or walk around your space.
Let your breathing settle into a comfortable rhythm.

warmup.name: Practise your hip hinge
cues: Soften your knees and send your hips back.
Stand up smoothly. Pause between a few practice reps.

warmup.name: Chair sit-to-stand
warmup.detail: Bodyweight · A stable chair against a wall
cues: Sit down gently, then stand through your whole feet.
Use a comfortable range and take pauses as needed.

warmup.name: Shoulder rolls
cues: Let your arms hang comfortably at your sides.
Circle your shoulders gently. Keep the movement small.

warmup.name: Easy wall push-ups
warmup.detail: A few gentle reps · No rush
cues: Keep a straight line from head to heels.
Feet closer to the wall makes it easier.

warmup.name: Practise your deadlift
warmup.detail: A few easy reps · Rest between attempts
cues: Send your hips back. Keep your back in its natural position.
Stand tall through your whole feet. Don’t lean back.

walking.name: Walk at your pace
walking.detail: Walk or march · You should be able to speak in full sentences
cues: Leave the kettlebell down. Walk or march without weights.
Keep a comfortable pace; slow down whenever you need.

cooldown.name: Slow things down
cues: Walk slowly and let your breathing settle.
Relax your shoulders. You’ve done the work.

cooldown.name: Gentle stretch & breathe
cues: Choose comfortable stretches. No bouncing or forcing.
Breathe normally and finish feeling settled.
